role: THE ONLY register of what currently blocks external beta. Historical RELEASE_BLOCKERS.md and REMAINING_BLOCKERS.md files under verification/ are historical evidence of blockers that were live at the time; they are not current status and must not be read as such.
scope: the Expert HazLenz layer and its product integration. The deterministic HazLenz product has its own release history and is not re-litigated here.

blocksExternalBetaNow.statement: Report generation returns 500 in every environment checked, because no object storage is configured.
blocksExternalBetaNow.why: neither STORAGE_S3_BUCKET nor STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT is set; src/storage/storage.service.ts selects the provider from NODE_ENV and both branches then refuse
blocksExternalBetaNow.nextAction: configure storage deliberately in a section authorized to do so

canRunInParallelWithTheBlockers.statement: Expert transmits zero governed records, so it can cite nothing. A server-side loader bound to the inspection's release binding would close it.

The Expert route runs its own deterministic analysis; the inspector sees a separately persisted one. Deciding whether they must be the same run is a product question that does not block the confirmation action.

§260 section 11 names six downstream consumers that must be blocked pre-confirmation. §265 activated ONE of them (finding finalization). Completion readiness / transition-to-completed, corrective-action creation, report finalization and export, notifications, and the executive summary are NOT yet guarded on the Expert path.
canRunInParallelWithTheBlockers.whyNotABlockerToday: each of the five reaches an Expert conclusion only through a finalized finding, and finalization is now gated. That is containment, not a guard: a future feature that reads an Expert analysis directly would bypass it.
canRunInParallelWithTheBlockers.dependsOn: nothing; the derivation and the leaf module both exist

canRunInParallelWithTheBlockers.statement: An ANALYSIS_CONFIRMED or ANALYSIS_OVERRIDDEN analysis cannot be re-opened or revised. The beta workflow is one settlement per analysis.
canRunInParallelWithTheBlockers.whyNotABlockerToday: §265 was instructed to carry it as deferred rather than implement it. It is not a statement that irreversibility is permanent product policy.
canRunInParallelWithTheBlockers.dependsOn: a product-owner decision about what re-opening means for an already-consumed downstream finding
